timing_contract.notes: The official display uses 001 at a beat boundary. Fixtures also use one-based ticks, including non-grid positions; their Song ppqn is 240.

capabilities.notes: Vendor: defines initial tempo, time signature, and optional preset/snapshot recall. Parser exposes those fields from the observed layout; other positions remain opaque.
Vendor: end position plus fade and playback/end behavior options. Only the observed label is exposed; option fields remain opaque because UI documentation does not prove serialized positions.

Vendor options include Pause at Marker, Count In, Cycle Marker, and preset/snapshot recall. Names and option values are fixture-confirmed; association of payload positions 3-9 with those UI options is inferred from field position.
A cycle is represented empirically by paired start/end payload types. Repeat count and one option are exposed without assigning undocumented meaning to the latter.
Vendor recalls a preset and/or snapshot. Setlist, preset, and snapshot positions are empirically interpreted.
Native Song flags are distinct from both global MIDI looper control sets. Observed label and action strings are exposed losslessly.

capabilities.notes: Incoming Bank Select and Program Change control Stadium preset recall; this is not a Showcase MIDI_BANK_PROGRAM flag sent on playback.
